name: DSH2Forsion
description: 把 DSH 工具、技能与模型来源接入 Tangu，把原版插件面板接入 Forsion。完整能力需要新版本机宿主。兼容 DeepSeek Harness，非 DeepSeek 官方出品。
descriptionEn: Use DSH tools, skills and model sources in Tangu, and original plugin panels in Forsion. Full support requires an updated local host. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness; not made or endorsed by DeepSeek.

onboarding.intro: 首次使用会下载兼容运行时（约 1.1 GB 磁盘）。在本页安装插件，从 Tangu 项目会话进入原版插件面板。

steps.title: 准备运行时
steps.description: 左侧 Ribbon 打开「DSH」。首次使用会说明下载内容与来源，你点击后才开始。

steps.title: 安装插件
steps.description: 在本页输入 npm 包名。先在临时副本试装、试启动，通过后再安装。

steps.title: 打开项目面板
steps.description: 先打开 Tangu 项目会话，再选择任务看板、技能管理或 Git Graph。看板任务由 Tangu 执行与审批，工具调用仍需原生批准。

en.intro: First use downloads the compatibility runtime (about 1.1 GB of disk). Install plugins here, then open their original panels from a Tangu project session.

steps.title: Prepare the runtime
steps.description: Open DSH from the Ribbon. First use explains the download and its source, and starts only when you click.

steps.title: Install plugins
steps.description: Enter an npm package name here. It is installed and started in a scratch copy first, and added only if that works.

steps.title: Open a project panel
steps.description: Open a Tangu project session, then select TaskBoard, Skills Manager or Git Graph. Tasks execute with Tangu approvals and history; tool calls still require native approval.
